image_description: A small, young wood rabbit (cottontail) sitting on a grey asphalt surface. The rabbit is facing away from the camera but turning its head slightly to the right. It has brownish-grey fur, long upright ears with pinkish interiors, and a visible white fluffy tail. The lighting appears natural, casting soft shadows.
